data_origin: All results are simulator-generated (virtual time) or real kernel TCP over loopback; none is a measurement of a real network.

environments.why_live_is_not_exposed: it needs sudo/CAP_NET_ADMIN to create network namespaces; the API never runs privileged operations

live_updates.reason: experiments run in the simulator's virtual time and produce their metrics only after the run has finished; there is no metric stream to forward, so a WebSocket would have nothing true to send. Poll GET /api/experiments/{id} and GET /api/experiments/{id}/transitions?after_seq=N.
